title: Kuddi Kosam Keewɗam
intro: E nder leydi ɓooyndi, won ruuhu ina darinoo e nder ɓurɓe alɗude e renndo maɓɓe. Barkeeji leydi ndii ina ngari e maɓɓe laabi ɗiɗi e nder duuɓi jokkondirɗi, ko ɗum huunde nde fotnoo hebbinde ɓerɗe maɓɓe e yettoore. Tee nde musiiba ari, kala ko 6e njoginoo, 6e 6amtaa e jamma gooto, jaabawol ma66e hollitii sifaa goonga oo e 6ernde ma66e. Mbele aɗa waawi udditaade sifaa ooɗoo limre nde daartol mum woni jeertinaango e majjere barkeeji Alla?
clues: Miɗo jeyaa e ɓerɗe ɓurɗe welde e leydi ndii fof, barkinaaɗo e nguura keewka.
Laabi ɗiɗi njuumri arii e am e nder duuɓi ɗiɗi, kono ɓernde am ina heddii ina yetta Joomiraawo am.
Miɗo joginoo ngesa mawka, ina waɗi leɗɗe ɓiɗɓe leɗɗe, leɗɗe oliif, e leɗɗe paltoor – ko ɗum seedantaagal moƴƴere Alla.
Nde jarne am yani, mi dariima e ŋoral mum, juuɗe am ina njuuti haa asamaan, miɗo huɗa hoddiro am.
Mi yeddi wonde Alla ina waawi saabaade hono ndee majjere, hay so tawii miɗo ɓuuɓna juuɗe am e nder jikke.
Jukkungo am wonaa tan majjude gesa am, kono ko heddaade e ŋoral mum haa laaɓi cer, mi waawaa noddude hay balloowo gooto.
